questions: Compare isolation benefits with coordination, cache writes and repeated repository exploration.
Keep root route fixed; separate native session resume from cross-provider handoff.
decision: Make delegation evidence-based and context-bounded; retain fresh cross-provider workers and do not enable transcript resumption by default.
code_observations: run_concise composes multiple runtime contracts, so tests of run_isolated alone do not cover the production prompt.

The current runner launches fresh workers and receives bounded task artifacts. Its run_process/pump_stream path accumulates captured output; large outputs require a bounded capture contract independent of the full disk log.
implementation_steps: Add deterministic delegation receipts recording role, read/write scope, capability floor, estimated coordination cost and reason for keeping work at root.
Use fresh workers for independent contexts or capability gaps. Keep small cohesive work local and prevent concurrent writers with overlapping scopes unless an explicit integration strategy exists.

Implement a bounded stream spool that drains stdout and stderr concurrently, preserves full owned logs on disk, and retains only the final structured envelope and bounded diagnostic windows in memory.
Keep worker prompt static prefixes stable in both raw and composed entrypoints. Use referenced artifacts rather than historical chat messages for cross-provider continuity.
Treat same-provider session resume as an opt-in future experiment with retention and cache accounting, not a hidden fallback that changes fresh-context semantics.
proposed_acceptance_tests: A noisy fake CLI emits many megabytes without proportional memory growth or pipe deadlock.
A final structured report remains recoverable after long tool output; missing or truncated envelopes fail visibly.
Two delegated writers cannot silently claim the same source scope.
Above-floor work cannot be retained on an underqualified worker merely to avoid coordination cost.
Prefix hashes match across tasks for raw and production entrypoints.

alternatives.title: Fresh worker for every small step
alternatives.tradeoff: Strong separation but needless startup, repeated reads and coordination.

alternatives.title: Selective isolation plus bounded output and artifact handoff
alternatives.tradeoff: Preserves resumability and reduces unrelated context with measurable overhead.

alternatives.title: Automatically resume all old sessions across retries
alternatives.tradeoff: Retains stale/incorrect context and transcripts, and cannot transparently cross providers.

cost_model: Account for startup, input, output, cache writes/reads and reviewer calls. Stable prompt text improves eligibility but is not proof of a cache hit or lower subscription usage.
unverified: No native subagent dispatch exists in this environment; this report does not claim an independent worker or measured cache hit.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
